**Word(s):**

**This pull request:**
- [ ] Adds a new word
- [ ] Adds papers to an existing word
- [ ] Improves an existing entry
- [ ] Changes something else (site, design, docs)

**Checklist for words and papers:**
- [ ] The word describes AI systems in language borrowed from human (or animal) life, and isn't already in the dictionary
- [ ] Every field is filled in, in my own words
- [ ] Every paper is peer-reviewed (journal or conference proceedings), and I checked its title, authors, year and venue against the DOI record or the publisher's page
- [ ] If an AI tool helped me draft, I checked every claim and paper myself
